label: Crypto relative momentum
desc: The fifty most liquid Kraken perpetuals ranked on five formation windows; long the top, short the bottom; 10% target, 30% per-name cap.
rule: five formation windows · rank across perpetuals · MaxPositionWeight 30% · 10% target, 3× cap
config:
crypto_momentum:
  target_risk: 0.1
  base_currency: USD
  constructor:
    type: RiskWeighted
  models:
  - name: xs_momentum_crypto
    risk_weight: 1.0
    timing:
      type: None
  portfolio_gearing:
    type: VolTarget
    params:
      target_vol: 0.1
      vol_lookback: 63
      annualization: 365
  portfolio_timing:
    type: None
  risk_controls:
  - type: MaxPositionWeight
    params:
      max_weight: 0.3
  - type: LeverageLimit
    params:
      max_leverage: 3.0
xs_momentum_crypto:
  universe_filters:
  - type: HistoryFilter
    params:
      min_days: 126
  - type: DataIntegrityFilter
  - type: AdvFilter
    params:
      min_adv: 100000
      lookback: 63
  vol_normalizer:
    type: Identity
  signals:
  - type: CrossSectionalSignal
    weight: 0.2
    params:
      vol_estimator: &id001
        type: EWMA2
        params:
          span: 32
      indicator:
        type: CumulativeReturn
        params:
          lookback: 30
          skip: 0
      ranker: &id002
        type: PercentileRank
        params:
          min_names: 15
      position_function: &id003
        type: QuantilePortfolio
        params:
          long_pct: 0.3
          short_pct: 0.3
          weighting: equal
          dollar_neutral: true
      risk_weighting: &id004
        type: InverseVol
        params:
          target_vol: 0.6
          floor: 0.35
      max_weight: 0.15
  - type: CrossSectionalSignal
    weight: 0.2
    params:
      vol_estimator: *id001
      indicator:
        type: CumulativeReturn
        params:
          lookback: 45
          skip: 0
      ranker: *id002
      position_function: *id003
      risk_weighting: *id004
      max_weight: 0.15
  - type: CrossSectionalSignal
    weight: 0.2
    params:
      vol_estimator: *id001
      indicator:
        type: CumulativeReturn
        params:
          lookback: 63
          skip: 0
      ranker: *id002
      position_function: *id003
      risk_weighting: *id004
      max_weight: 0.15
  - type: CrossSectionalSignal
    weight: 0.2
    params:
      vol_estimator: *id001
      indicator:
        type: CumulativeReturn
        params:
          lookback: 90
          skip: 0
      ranker: *id002
      position_function: *id003
      risk_weighting: *id004
      max_weight: 0.15
  - type: CrossSectionalSignal
    weight: 0.2
    params:
      vol_estimator: *id001
      indicator:
        type: CumulativeReturn
        params:
          lookback: 126
          skip: 0
      ranker: *id002
      position_function: *id003
      risk_weighting: *id004
      max_weight: 0.15
  asset_allocator:
    type: Identity
  model_gearing:
    type: XSVolTarget
    params:
      target_vol: 0.2
      vol_lookback: 63
      leverage_cap: 3.0
      annualization: 365
  cost_model:
    type: InstrumentCostModel
    params: {}
  rebalance: daily
  position_smoothing: 10
